info.title: HiringJet Partner API
info.description:
REST API for creating and publishing job requisitions. JSON request and response bodies. Standard HTTP verbs and status codes.

Jobs use external apply only (EXTERNAL_LINK and externalApplicationLink). This API does not expose applications.

## Authentication

Send `X-HJ-API-KEY` and `X-HJ-API-SECRET` on every request. Enter the public key and the secret in the panel on the right before you send a test call.

A live key is accepted only from an allowlisted IP. A test key is not checked against that list.

## Publish

`POST /v2/jobs` creates, updates, and publishes. Omit `jobId` to create a draft. Send `jobId` to update that draft. Set `publish` to true to publish, which checks the completed job.

| Key | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Test | Approved immediately and indexed with `sandboxPublished` true. Unlimited. Search hides it unless `sandboxPublished` is requested. |
| Live | Goes directly live (`ACTIVE`), `jobOrigin=PARTNER_API`. Unlimited. Does not consume Jet Screen `JOB_POST` credits. |

## Retries and limits

Send `Idempotency-Key` on POST and PATCH. A retry with the same key returns the original response.

The limit is 120 requests per minute per organisation. Successful responses include `X-RateLimit-Limit` and `X-RateLimit-Remaining`.

post.description:
One call. Omit jobId to create a draft. Send jobId to update that draft. Set publish to true to publish after the write.
A draft requires jobTitle on create. Publish uses the same completed-job rules as the employer portal (description, location, skills, apply method, and related fields). Organisation and user ids are taken from the API key.
A test key then goes LIVE and indexes with sandboxPublished true. A live key goes LIVE (ACTIVE) immediately — no approval queue and no JOB_POST credit.

- `Specialization`
- `Nationality`
- `VisaStatus`

- `VisaSponsorCountry`

jobId.description: Omit to create. Send the id of an editable draft to update it.

publish.description: True publishes after the write. Test and Live keys both return LIVE (Active). Omit or false saves a draft.

applicationMethod.description: Must be EXTERNAL_LINK when sent. New jobs are stored as EXTERNAL_LINK.

JobWrite.description:
Omit jobId to create. Send jobId to update that draft. Set publish to true to publish after the write.
Organisation and user come from the API key. Do not send organisationId, organisationUserId, draft, step, or jobPostId.
A draft requires jobTitle on create. Other fields are optional on create and update. Partner jobs always use external apply (EXTERNAL_LINK). Publish uses the same completed-job rules as the employer portal.
